tasks.gr9-weathering-erosion-t3: Topic: Weathering and Erosion. Cover physical, chemical, and biological weathering; erosion types; and deposition processes. Ask learners to identify weathering types, explain the cycle, describe erosional landforms, or distinguish between weathering and erosion.
tasks.gr9-river-coastal-landscapes-t3: Topic: River and Coastal Landscapes. Cover river courses, fluvial landforms, coastal processes, and feature formation. Ask learners to describe river valley development, explain coastal features, or analyze how water shapes landscapes.
tasks.gr9-glaciation-wind-action-t3: Topic: Glaciation and Wind Action. Cover glacial erosion, glacial landforms, wind erosion, and desert landscapes. Ask learners to identify glacial features, describe wind erosion processes, or explain landscape formation.
tasks.gr9-soil-erosion-management-t3: Topic: Soil Erosion and Management. Cover erosion types, causes, impacts, and conservation strategies. Ask learners to identify erosion causes, explain impacts, propose management solutions, or discuss soil conservation techniques.
